problem: Let X be a connected compact complex n-fold, with a smooth strictly positive probability volume dV and dd^c=(i/(2 pi))partial barpartial. All quasi-psh and psh potentials are genuine canonical upper representatives; arbitrary almost-everywhere modifications are excluded. A smooth real background theta is nef if theta+epsilon h has a strictly positive smooth dd^c-potential representative for every epsilon>0, where h is a fixed Hermitian metric; it is big if theta+dd^c u>=delta h for some delta>0 and genuine global quasi-psh u. Neither property assumes d-closedness. The extended Monge-Ampere measure MA_ext_theta is the genuine non-pluripolar product with smooth-background correction terms. For Hermitian h, v_-(h) is the infimum of integral MA_h(u) over all bounded genuine h-psh potentials. For nonzero f>=0 in L1(dV), let c_h(min(f,k)) be the scalar of the supremum-normalized continuous bounded-density equation and b_h(f)=lim_k c_h(min(f,k)); equivalently b_h(f) is the largest coefficient a>=0 of a genuine subsolution MA_ext_h(s)>=a f dV. If b_h(f)>0, the greatest exponential solution u_lambda of MA_ext_h(u_lambda)=exp(lambda u_lambda)f dV exists for every lambda>0, is genuine, has finite mass, and dominates every exponential subsolution. Set v_lambda=u_lambda-sup_X u_lambda and c_lambda=exp(lambda sup_X u_lambda). Known scalar and measure convergence c_lambda->b_h(f) and exp(lambda u_lambda)f->b_h(f)f in L1 does not by itself prove convergence of v_lambda. The available lower barrier contains the actual scalar error lambda^(-1)log(c_lambda/b_h(f)); this term cannot be discarded. If v_-(h)>0, every L1 cluster of v_lambda converges in capacity and solves the exact threshold equation in the zero-reference envelope class, but this still need not identify a single potential. For a smooth big possibly nonclosed theta define P_theta(a) as the usc envelope of genuine theta-psh potentials <=a, u preceq phi as u<=phi+C, and P_theta[u](phi)=(lim_{C->infinity}P_theta(min(u+C,phi)))^*. An ordinary model reference has sup phi=0 and P_theta[phi](0)=phi. The relative envelope class E_env(X,theta,phi) consists of u preceq phi such that for every real t>=1 there exists a genuine theta-psh a with t^(-1)a+(1-t^(-1))phi<=u; the convex inequality is meaningful even at common poles. Do not replace this definition in unrestricted settings by zero-obstacle envelope equality, whose converses need additional hypotheses. Ordinary bounded type u~phi means mutual inequalities up to finite constants, interpreted with common poles. When using prescribed references, state which of these classes is used and how the exponential density is weighted at poles. Original S05 asks for conditions ensuring whole-family convergence of normalized greatest positive-exponent solutions to a canonically selected zero-exponent potential, first for fixed density and reference and then for varying model references and densities while retaining the limiting type. A useful selection must have a proved variational or order characterization, particularly for L1 data; uniqueness of the scalar alone is insufficient. General zero-exponent potentials are not unique, including smooth or real-analytic density examples, so do not claim universal potential uniqueness. Additional already established background: for nonzero Lp data p>1 and an arbitrary smooth big theta in minimal ordinary type, the entire centered exponential family u_lambda-lambda^(-1)log c(f) converges locally uniformly off an analytic strict barrier and in L1. Its limit is the greatest continuous minimal-type critical subsolution whose integrals against every supporting probability of r->log c(f)-log c(exp(r)f) are <=0. Smooth strictly positive or specified semipositive dual maximizers also give existing selection results. These known cases are not new S05 progress. No new selection criterion, density family, reference family, theorem or proof is supplied.
completionCriteria: Prove a substantive new selection or stability theorem addressing genuine L1 data beyond the already resolved Lp and smooth-adjoint cases, or a new singular-reference/varying-data regime, with a nontrivial admissible example. Give a precise normalization, selected potential, intrinsic variational or order characterization, topology, finite mass and exact zero-exponent equation. Establish retention of the limiting reference type when it varies, rather than assuming it. Scalar convergence or a restatement that all cluster limits agree is not itself a criterion. Verify indispensable exact external hypotheses at primary sources and independently reconstruct the argument. Restricted sufficient conditions remain scoped; the entire original programme cannot be marked solved from one such result.
